paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between batch size and throughput for two different caching methods. The x-axis is labeled “Batch Size” and is linear, ranging from 0 to 60 with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “Throughput (token/s)” and is linear, ranging from 0 to 2500 with tick labels at intervals of 500.  A pink line, marked with circular data points, represents “PyramidInfer,” starting at approximately 200 tokens/s at a batch size of 0, rising to approximately 2350 tokens/s at a batch size of 60. A green line, marked with circular data points, represents “Full Cache,” starting at approximately 200 tokens/s at a batch size of 0, increasing to approximately 1150 tokens/s at a batch size of 20, and then decreasing to approximately 950 tokens/s at a batch size of 60.
